I recently had an Astrology and Astrocartography consultation with Amit ji, and it was a truly eye-opening experience. He was incredibly patient with all my questions—even when I asked him to explain the houses and chart details in depth so I could really understand my own chart better.

What stood out most was the way he explained things with such positivity. Instead of making planets feel like punishments, he helped me see them as guides—showing me how each planet is working in my favor and how I can align with their guidance to move through life lessons with more awareness.

Astrocartography was completely new for me, and he took the time to share detailed maps and clear guidance on locations, helping me see where I could experience more flow, luck, and growth.

Unlike many astrology consultations that can leave you feeling fearful or burdened with expensive remedies, I walked away from this session feeling hopeful, empowered, and supported with practical, spiritual remedies that didn’t require me to invest more money at all.

I’m deeply grateful for the experience and would highly recommend a consultation with Amit ji to anyone looking for clarity, direction, and a positive, empowering perspective on their life journey.
